guidelines.detail: same as LRN-004 (The validator record reports an invalid xs:ID, which this guideline addresses. It matches learned guideline LRN-004. Note that the displayed value, “Gateway_ExtensionDecision,” appears to be a valid xs:ID, so the record does not reveal what made the actual value fail validation.)

same as LRN-005 (The description gives a progression of activities, and the records show missing sequence flows across that progression and its decision or synchronization points. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-005.)

same as LRN-012 (The description supports the generated labels’ core actions, while some reference labels add details not stated in the description. The learned guideline already covers preserving the described meaning and avoiding unsupported additions.)

same as LRN-005 (The description places the decision about extending leave at the end of the period, and the corresponding transition is absent from the generated model. This supports preserving explicitly stated order and transitions; learned guideline LRN-005 already says essentially the same thing.)

same as LRN-012 (The description says to decide about an extension, while the reference label adds a return-to-work alternative not stated in the description. The guideline captures the supported faithfulness principle and is essentially the same as LRN-012.)

same as LRN-005 (The missing-flow records show omitted transitions along the process path. This is already captured by learned guideline LRN-005, which covers ordered activities and transitions through branches or synchronization points.)

same as LRN-012 (P2 shows that the description’s stated details can be lost in a broader label, while P1 shows an unsupported outcome added to a label. The proposed guidance is already covered by learned guideline LRN-012.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description is being translated into a BPMN XML model: Assign every BPMN element an id that is a valid XML Schema xs:ID value, following the XML name lexical rules, and ensure the ids are unique.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description is being translated into a BPMN XML model

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents distinct activities in an ordered progression, including transitions into, through, or out of branches or synchronization points: Connect each consecutive activity with a sequence flow, preserving the stated transitions through branches and synchronization points.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents distinct activities in an ordered progression, or identifies when a decision or synchronization occurs

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a specific activity or process-ending outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or end event with a concise phrase that preserves the stated action or outcome; do not substitute a related action or add an unsupported one.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or decision without specifying additional actions or outcomes
